topic.source_contract: Brownfield Land Register and Permission in Principle evidence

facts.parts: Part 1 suitable brownfield sites; Part 2 subset granted PiP
facts.guard: Part 1 entry is not planning permission
PiP alone does not authorise development
data-standard compliance is not site delivery evidence

facts.technical_details: design, mitigation and infrastructure assessed later
facts.guard: Part 2 is not full planning permission
local register status must be checked authority by authority

scope_guards: Part 1 and Part 2 entries remain distinct.
Part 1 inclusion is not planning permission or an allocation by itself.
Part 2 Permission in Principle settles only location, land use and amount.
Technical Details Consent is still required before development can proceed.
Register data can include sites with or without an extant planning permission.
Authority register date, geometry, ownership status and planning chronology require exact review.
Open-data publication is not evidence of viability, funding, title or implementation.
No score or promotion is written without exact current register entry, PiP status, TDC and title evidence.
